clue.text: Setting of limits by Conservative stirred minor critics up

indicators.note: stirred means mixed about, so the words minor critics up are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Tory curbs the impact of a few petty critics by riling them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stirred' and 'up' look like one phrasal verb, but 'up' is part of the fodder for the 'stirred' rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: To circumscribe is to draw a boundary round something, so this is the act of restricting.

clue.text: Type of training electrician puts in

definitions.meaning: ... training is a regime of exercises done at a series of stations
an electrician installs an electrical loop of wiring in a house

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are the same word: an exercise routine round stations, and a wiring loop.

clue.text: Called direction shown by compass

parts.note: called on the phone means rang
E is east, a compass direction

explanation.surface: Someone phoned to say which way the compass pointed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'compass' looks like part of the direction clue but is the definition, meaning scope.
explanation.definitionFit: Compass in the sense of scope or extent is a synonym for the span of something.

clue.text: Runs a live broadcast worldwide

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of runs a live are scattered and reassembled

explanation.surface: A news channel airs live coverage that reaches the whole globe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges RUNS A LIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something found everywhere in the world is general or all-embracing.

clue.text: Cutting a garment

definitions.meaning: a gardener's cutting taken from a plant for propagation
a woman's undergarment worn beneath a dress

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a twig cut for planting and a petticoat-like underdress.

clue.text: Rehearses extras?

definitions.meaning: to rehearse lines is to practise them again
extras are ... and above what is needed, with the question mark marking the playful reading

explanation.definitionFit: Going through again is to rehearse; and surplus scoring is runs beyond the required amount.

clue.text: Leading artist goes to party in foreign gallery

parts.note: PRA is President of the Royal Academy, the leading British artist
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A top painter heads off to a celebration at an overseas museum.
explanation.walkthrough: PRA (President of the Royal Academy) is the head of the London academy of artists. The PRADO is Madrid's national art gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: The museum in Madrid is a famous art collection outside Britain.

clue.text: Precaution taken in case run goes badly

indicators.note: something that goes badly goes wrong, so the letters of case run are jumbled

explanation.surface: A cautious batsman protects himself in case his run goes wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in case' reads as a phrase in the surface, but 'in' is kept as written and 'case' joins 'run' under 'goes badly'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cover taken against possible loss is a safeguard arranged in advance.

clue.text: Arrange when to marry — beginning of March for David, say

definitions.meaning: to name the day is to fix a wedding date

definitions.text: beginning of March for David, say
definitions.meaning: St David's feast falls on 1 March, his saint's festival

explanation.walkthrough: St David is the patron saint of Wales; a person named David may celebrate on his feast day, 1 March.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both the idiom for fixing a wedding date and a saint's feast day kept by namesakes.

clue.text: Translation of right version of text about Newton

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the version of text goes around the letter for Newton

parts.note: an edition is a version of a text
N is the symbol for the newton, the unit of force

explanation.surface: A translator works on the right edition of a book about Isaac Newton.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts N inside EDITION, after R.
explanation.definitionFit: A rendering of a piece into another language or form is an interpretation of it.

clue.text: A state in America rebuffed one in India

indicators.note: rebuffed suggests being pushed back, so the state's abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: MASS is the abbreviation for Massachusetts

explanation.surface: An American state turned down an approach from an Indian one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rebuffed' turns MASS into SSAM. ASSAM is a state in north-east India.
explanation.definitionFit: The tea-growing region is one of the states of India.

clue.text: Of variable quality — isn't that odd?

definitions.meaning: a number that is not even is odd, read as un- plus a word for divisible by two

explanation.definitionFit: Patchy work is inconsistent, and an odd number is one that is not divisible by two.

clue.text: Showed embarrassment when put in the shade

definitions.meaning: given a shade or tint, that is tinted

explanation.definitionFit: Blushing is reddening in the face, and something given a tint has been dyed or painted.

clue.text: The party to beat?

explanation.definitionFit: Informally a wild celebration, and as a verb to flog or defeat heavily.

clue.text: They may hoist the flag, though not the winners

definitions.text: They may hoist the flag, though not the winners

parts.words: They may hoist the flag, though not the winners
parts.note: people who send a flag up a pole, read alongside those who finish second in a contest

explanation.definitionFit: Those placed just behind the victors in a race or competition.

clue.text: Delightful quarter in port, extremely lively

indicators.note: in means the quarter is placed within the word for port

parts.note: a haven is a harbour or port
E, east, is a quarter of the compass

indicators.note: extremely means taking the extremes, the first and last letters, of lively

explanation.surface: A lively district in a harbour town makes for a wonderful visit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quarter' is a compass point here, not a district of a town, and 'in' places it inside the port.
explanation.definitionFit: Something wonderful is so lovely it seems divine.

clue.text: Insure against illness in short holiday at Nice, perhaps

parts.note: vac is short for vacation, a holiday

indicators.note: perhaps signals that at Nice may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: Before a quick break on the Riviera, it is wise to get protected against disease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nice' is the French city in the surface, its capital letter hiding its role as plain fodder for 'perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving a jab protects a person from catching a disease.

clue.text: Lazy daughter giving way to son that's cheeky

indicators.note: giving way to means one letter yields its place to another

parts.note: indolent means lazy

explanation.surface: An idle girl gives in to her mouthy brother.
explanation.walkthrough: In INDOLENT, D (daughter) is replaced by S (son).
explanation.definitionFit: Being rude and disrespectful is impudence or cheek.

clue.text: Daughter, fishing, is kept in suspense

parts.note: angling is fishing with rod and line

explanation.surface: A girl out with a rod waits anxiously for a bite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kept in suspense' reads as anxiety but means literally hanging.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanging loosely in the air is being suspended.

clue.text: Plan to set up assistance having little weight

indicators.note: set up in a down clue means the word for assistance is written bottom to top

parts.note: aid is assistance
a gram is a small unit of weight

explanation.surface: A scheme to organise help comes with a small weight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns AID into DIA.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawing or chart laying out how something is arranged is a plan.

clue.text: Unduly long exposition of singular doctrine

parts.note: S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular
a creed is a doctrine or set of beliefs

explanation.surface: A preacher delivers a long-winded account of one particular belief.
explanation.definitionFit: A tediously long piece of writing or speech is a rant or tirade.

clue.text: Record tailless bird in spot

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record

indicators.note: tailless means the last letter is cut off the bird

parts.note: an erne is a sea eagle

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher notes a bird missing its tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tailless' cuts the final E from ERNE, leaving ERN.
explanation.definitionFit: To make out or detect something is to notice it.

clue.text: Disinclination to maintain offspring one accepted

parts.note: to aver is to assert or maintain

indicators.note: accepted means taken in, so the boy holds the numeral one inside

parts.note: a son is offspring
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A parent is reluctant to support the child once he has been taken in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to maintain offspring' suggests child support, but 'maintain' means assert, and 'accepted' takes the numeral into the child.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong dislike or reluctance towards something.

clue.text: Raise moveable shelter for travellers out East

indicators.note: moveable means the letters of raise can be moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: Travellers in the East put up a portable shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moveable' rearranges RAISE. A SERAI is a caravanserai, an inn for travellers in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: A caravanserai is an inn in the Middle East or Asia where caravans rest.

clue.text: Fare from Venezuela's capital is also included

indicators.note: capital means the first letter of Venezuela
included means the word for also is put inside the word is

parts.note: and means also, in addition

explanation.surface: Food from Caracas is part of the package as well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like Caracas but takes the first letter of Venezuela; 'included' places the word for also inside 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Viands is an old word for food or provisions, the fare served at a table.

clue.text: Racket created by hooter going about one

indicators.note: going about means wrapping round, so the word for hooter surrounds the numeral

parts.note: hooter is slang for the nose
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A car horn sounding round a single person makes a din.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going about' puts I inside NOSE. 'Hooter' looks like a car horn but is slang for nose.
explanation.definitionFit: A racket is a loud din or sound.

clue.text: Knock out plug

definitions.meaning: in boxing, to halt an opponent so the fight is ended
a bung that blocks an opening

explanation.definitionFit: A boxer halting a bout, and a stopper that blocks a hole.

clue.text: For part of flight, a plane taking off, for example?

definitions.meaning: the vertical board of a step in a flight of stairs

definitions.text: a plane taking off, for example?
definitions.meaning: something going up, such as an aircraft climbing

explanation.definitionFit: The upright part of a stair step, and anything that ascends.

clue.text: Send abroad for trial run with new diet

parts.note: in cricket an extra is a run not scored off the bat

indicators.note: new signals a fresh arrangement of the letters of diet

explanation.surface: A fugitive is sent overseas to face justice, with a new eating plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges DIET into DITE. In cricket, extras (byes, wides) are runs credited without the batsman hitting the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Handing a suspect to another country to stand trial there.

clue.text: Devilish mate — one with help assembled to seize stricken ship

indicators.note: to seize means to grab hold of, so the jumbled group surrounds the other jumbled word
assembled means put together in a new order, so mate one help are rearranged
stricken means damaged, so the letters of ship are rearranged

explanation.surface: A friend gathers help to board a damaged vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: Two anagrams nest here: 'assembled' works on mate one help, 'stricken' on ship, and 'to seize' sets the second inside the first after its opening two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Mephistopheles is the devil of the Faust legend, so this means fiendish.
